recommendation.reason: 经常在 DSH 处理没有专用 API 的界面的开发者，可以先用合成窗口和本地表单评估定向能力。相比人工切换窗口，插件让文本模型在当前会话观察控件、执行动作并回读变化。若上传范围、输入目标或恢复结果无法独立核对，就保留人工操作或既有专用脚本。

研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：核实 DSH 文本模型能否定位并操作指定浏览器或 macOS 窗口，界定全局权限、失败与退出。 ### Q01 · 谁会用文本模型操作界面，怎样从注册走到可观察结果？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、功能与机制、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 目标是在 DSH 经常处理无专用 API 的本地浏览器表单或 macOS 窗口的开发者。原办法是人工操作，或为网页逐站编写 Playwright 流程。Cordis 补丁插入宿主服务和全局工具两行。两个工具把有 agent 的调用传给共享运行时，以 agent ID 分隔观察记录和浏览器上下文。观察返回有上限的语义文本、快照 ID、警告和可选调试图路径。动作通过浏览器或桌面驱动执行，再返回变化观察。其增量是统一浏览器与桌面交互入口，并提供文本模型可引用的控件编号。成功提交的业务状态仍需看界面或目标数据。全局继承扩大工具可见范围，具体宿主限制由宿主另行施加。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:51-67](https://github.com/ZRui-C/dsh-computer-use/blob/1dd014943f8ae2f05f50872f36f95fff1b094e4e/README.md#L51-L67) 作者描述文本感知、浏览器与桌面差异。
查看原文（17行） ```text ## What it does | Surface | Perception | Input | | --- | --- | --- | | Chromium | Playwright, CDP accessibility/DOM, frames, tabs, optional OCR | Ref-pinned navigation, pointer, keyboard, forms, scroll, drag, upload | | macOS | Accessibility tree first, Vision OCR for semantic gaps, independent window capture | AX actions, targeted SkyLight/CoreGraphics, global HID only without a target | Every action returns a fresh bounded text observation. The model works with roles, names, values, state, geometry, and stable snapshot refs instead of assuming it can inspect screenshots. UI and OCR strings are explicitly untrusted data. ### Background macOS control - Carries PID, WindowServer window ID, AX window frame, and element identity through every action. - Prefers semantic AX actions before coordinate input. - Routes supported pointer and keyboard events directly to the target process/window. - Uses a click-through software cursor; targeted actions do not move the physical pointer. - Keeps post-action observation pinned to the previous target, even while another app stays active. - Falls back to public CoreGraphics or fails closed when a private capability is unavailable. ```
